text: The proposed update extends the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. That reduction is operationally promising. The result might therefore seem, on this evidence alone, to support broad rollout; more precisely, the evidence supports only a limited experiment, not broad rollout. Here is the boundary: the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence. That specific evidence limit blocks the broader action without negating the positive operational evaluation. Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout.
